newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 92-day t-bill rate edges down to 5.54 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 92-day t-bill rate edges down to 5.54 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for ten million dinars of 92-day Bahrain treasury bills edged lower to 5.54 percent from 5.55 percent for 91-day bills a week earlier, a Bahrain Monetary Agency spokesman said.
The average price dropped to 98.604 from 98.615 last week and the minimum price accepted was 98.598.
Banks submitted bids for 23.76 million dinars worth of bills, down from 25.7 million dinars the previous week.
The bills are offered on Monday and issued on Wednesday.
